items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Lily and them would pick it up. From me just starting it, and go right on with me. And play it.

ctx.x: Well, I'll tell you what. I'd be out there on the floor singing. And like if I finished this song, somebody would say to me, 'Alberta, sing so and so and so,' I would start it out in the middle of the floor in Dreamland -- and you don't know how big Dreamland was, do you. It was almost a block square, Dreamland was. And I would start the song and
Lily and them would pick it up. From me just starting it, and go right on with me. And play it. I don't know.
But could Lily, for instance, from the stage could she hear you?
